desc:
(EN) 🔥 Welcome to BABYMONSTER Card World! [ NEW UPDATE] 😈

Enter the massive world of idol collecting! Can you find and collect over 300+ Unique Cards? Roll for your luck, build your showroom, and TRADE with friends to complete your album!

✨ GAME FEATURES:

📚 Massive Collection: Over 700+ Cards to discover (Debut to newest era!)

🔁 Trading System: Swap duplicates with others to get the cards you need.

🎲 RNG Luck: Roll for SECRET, SUPA, and rare Member cards.

🏠 Decorate: Build the coolest base to flex your best items.

💸 Tycoon: Earn passive income to roll faster.

💖 Collect all 7 Members: Ahyeon, Chiquita, Pharita, Ruka, Asa, Rami, Rora.

👍 Please LIKE & ⭐ FAVORITE to support the game for more updates!

BABYMONSTER, KPOP, Idol, Card, Simulator, RNG, Tycoon, Collection, Ahyeon, Chiquita, Pharita, Ruka, Asa, Rami, Rora, YG.
